mechanism: NSAIDs may reduce the contraceptive efficacy of progestins through effects on enterohepatic circulation and potential COX inhibition of endometrial prostaglandins; additionally, both drugs increase gastrointestinal bleeding risk.
action: Counsel patients on potential reduced contraceptive efficacy and consider backup contraception during ketorolac use; monitor for signs of GI bleeding and use lowest effective NSAID dose for shortest duration.
